integrity: Symbolic finite-state recurrence proves the bivariate identity and exact shortest-length phase transition; an analytic simple-pole argument proves the first-moment rate. The packaged executable offers finite cross-checks, not a formal infinite proof. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed binary alphabet; forbid only a single maximal one-run threshold; r fixed for n-to-infinity rate. Full finite-alphabet generalizations and uniform-in-r errors not asserted. Published work could contain an overlooked equivalent formulation.
title: Exact subsequence-universality distribution of binary run-limited languages
